verdict.rationale: Weave automatically tracks token usage and cost per call using built-in pricing for supported integrations, with costs shown in the trace tree and calls table in the Weave UI, plus custom cost support for unsupported models; calls table is filterable/aggregable by model and time via the trace UI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pre-built cost dashboards aggregating by time period across the whole org, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
